c001.title: Nice to meet you
c001.story: It is Anna's first week at college in Kyiv. Tonight there is a [[party]] for new [[students|student]]. A man says, "Hi, everyone, [[welcome]]!" Many [[people]] smile and clap. Anna sees a tall boy alone. She says, "[[Hello|hello]]! I am Anna." He says, "I am Max. [[Nice|nice]] to meet you!" They dance and laugh all night. The music is [[cool]], and the food is [[good]]. At the end, Anna and Max are [[friends|friend]]. Then Max's cousin Leo comes and says, "Hey, [[amigo]]!" Max and Leo were [[comrades|comrade]] at a sports camp. Now Kyiv feels like home to Anna.

c002.title: Lost on the first day
c002.story: Anna is late on her first day. At the door, she is in [[trouble]]. A guard says, "Your [[ID]], [[please]]." Anna opens her bag. "[[Sorry|sorry]], [[sir]]. One [[moment]]." Then she cannot find room twelve. A young woman sits at the desk. Anna asks, "Excuse me, [[Miss]], where is it?" "It is [[easy]]. Go up and left." Anna says, "[[OK]], thank you!" On the stairs, an old man drops his keys. "Excuse me, [[mister]], your keys!" says Anna. In room twelve, the teacher is [[Mrs.]] Koval. Anna whispers, "Good morning, [[madam]]." The teacher smiles and says, "Good morning, [[ladies|lady]] and [[gentlemen|gentleman]]!" Anna sits down just in time.

c006.title: Lunch near college
c006.story: Anna and Max have [[lunch]] near their college. They read the [[menu]]. Max orders [[soup]] and a [[sandwich]]. Anna wants a salad with [[dressing]]. She also takes chicken with [[rice]] and [[sauce]]. The food is hot and very tasty. For [[dessert]], Anna has cake and tea. Max eats half of her cake! Anna laughs. "Next time, you pay!" Max says, "Deal! Sunday [[brunch]] is on me."

c007.title: Coffee before class
c007.story: Max meets Anna at a [[coffee shop]] before class. The place has a great [[vibe]]. It is full of [[hipsters|hipster]] with laptops. The [[barista]] makes Anna a [[latte]]. It is from a new [[blend]]. Max orders a [[cappuccino]] with [[caramel]]. He tastes it slowly and nods. Anna laughs. "You are a real coffee [[snob]]!" They also take a [[croissant]]. Then Max wants a strong [[espresso]] too. They run to class, cups in hand. After class, they are very hungry. The [[cafe]] next door has only cakes. So they go to a little [[bistro]] for dinner.

c008.title: Pizza night
c008.story: On Friday, Max wants to [[chill]] at home. Anna and two friends come over. They order a big [[pizza]] for [[delivery]]. "What [[topping]] do we want?" asks Anna. "[[Pepperoni|pepperoni]] and [[mozzarella]]!" says Max. His sister adds, "And [[salami]] for me!" It is huge, with a [[diameter]] of forty centimeters. They also get [[cola]], [[nachos]], and other [[snacks|snack]]. Then Max makes [[popcorn]], and they watch a movie. Soon everybody is asleep on the sofa.
